scope: Component validation in a disposable privileged CT with host GPU, 720x1280, on an isolated bridge without a physical uplink; followed by user-authorized deployment to the original CT.
root_cause: Android 13 libcutils creates unsealed memfds; this Chromium version requires F_SEAL_GROW and F_SEAL_SHRINK before accepting a memfd as a shared memory region.
